title: 1996. Decimal to Binary Conversion Using Stack

Decimal to Binary Conversion Using Stack
30
Easy
Problem Statement
Given a non-negative integer, convert it to its binary representation using a stack.
Description
Read an integer n. Repeatedly divide n by 2, pushing each remainder onto a stack, until n becomes 0. Then pop all the remainders off the stack to build the binary representation, since a stack naturally reverses the order in which the remainders were generated.
Input Description
A single line containing an integer n (0 ≤ n ≤ 1000000).
Output Description
Print the binary representation of n. If n is 0, print "0".
Sample Input
13
Sample Output
1101
